use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};

pub type Numbers = Vec<f64>;
pub type Alias = String;

/// The top level.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct TopLevel {
    pub big: Option<i64>,

    /// A camel case property.
    pub camel_case_prop: Option<String>,

    pub half: Option<i64>,

    pub kebab: Kebab,

    pub list: Option<Vec<TopLeve>>,

    pub maybe_self: Option<Box<TopLeve>>,

    pub mixed: Option<Mixed>,

    #[serde(rename = "ünicode\u{2028}name")]
    pub nicode_name: Option<bool>,

    pub nullable_recursive_union: Option<NullableRecursiveUnion>,

    pub pascal: Option<Pascal>,

    pub recursive_union: RecursiveUnion,

    pub screaming: Option<Screaming>,

    pub small: i32,

    #[serde(rename = "self")]
    pub top_level_self: Box<TopLeve>,

    #[serde(rename = "type")]
    pub top_level_type: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "kebab-case")]
pub enum Kebab {
    #[serde(rename = "one-two")]
    OneTwo,

    #[serde(rename = "three-four")]
    ThreeFour,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(untagged)]
pub enum RecursiveUnion {
    PurpleString(String),

    TopLeve(Box<TopLeve>),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(untagged)]
pub enum NullableRecursiveUnion {
    PurpleString(String),

    TopLeve(Box<TopLeve>),
}

/// The top level.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct TopLeve {
    pub big: Option<i64>,

    /// A camel case property.
    pub camel_case_prop: Option<String>,

    pub half: Option<i64>,

    pub kebab: Kebab,

    pub list: Option<Vec<TopLeve>>,

    pub maybe_self: Option<Box<TopLeve>>,

    pub mixed: Option<Mixed>,

    #[serde(rename = "ünicode\u{2028}name")]
    pub nicode_name: Option<bool>,

    pub nullable_recursive_union: Option<NullableRecursiveUnion>,

    pub pascal: Option<Pascal>,

    pub recursive_union: RecursiveUnion,

    pub screaming: Option<Screaming>,

    pub small: i32,

    #[serde(rename = "self")]
    pub top_leve_self: Box<TopLeve>,

    #[serde(rename = "type")]
    pub top_leve_type: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub enum Mixed {
    #[serde(rename = "a b")]
    AB,

    #[serde(rename = "c-d")]
    CD,

    #[serde(rename = "eF")]
    EF,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Pascal {
    #[serde(rename = "OneTwo")]
    OneTwo,

    Three,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE")]
pub enum Screaming {
    #[serde(rename = "ONE_TWO")]
    OneTwo,

    Three,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(untagged)]
pub enum Choice {
    Integer(i64),

    PurpleString(String),
}
